old_policy.stdout_stderr: Memory-only bounded capture; discard after deriving receipt. No raw stdout/stderr or OS logs persisted.
old_policy.receipt: Only bounded typed outcome/exit/signal/limits, digests, run identity and fixed diagnostic codes; no free-text payload or report content. Hashes are identifiers, not anonymization guarantees.
old_policy.capacity: 100 receipts or1MiB total, whichever first; refuse new work when full rather than delete silently.
old_policy.deletion: Human-controlled local deletion/export; no automatic expiration.
old_policy.reservation: Before launch reserve1receipt slot and8192bytes; refuse if count+1>100 or used_bytes+8192>1048576. No automatic deletion.
